title: 夏季山居圖（1997.104）
title_orig: Mountain Village Embraced by the Summer
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1997.104）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1659」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Mountain Village Embraced by the Summer
Bequest of Mrs. A. Dean Perry

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Hironobu Kohara 古原宏伸, Tamaki Ogawa 小川環樹, and Roderick Whitfield. Un Juhei, Ō Ki 惲壽平 王翬. Tōkyō: Chūō Kōronsha, 1979.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 165, pl. 77）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 240, pp. 325-326）
Suzuki, Kei. Comprehensive Illustrated Catalog of Chinese Paintings. [Tokyo]: University of Tokyo Press, 1982.（Mentioned and Reproduced: A23-012, p. I-287）
Yang, Kathleen 楊凱琳, and Chi-chʻien Wang 王季遷. Through a Chinese connoisseur's eye: private notes of C.C. Wang 王季遷讀書筆記. Beijing: Zhong hua shu ju, 2010.（Mentioned: p. 313, no. 35）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text: Artist's inscription, signature, and 3 seals: [seal] Ouxie 偶諧. In the jihai year [1659], the fourth lunar month, I painted this for T'o-weng, my senior in our literary club, for your amusement and correction. Your junior Wang Shimin. [seals] Wang Shimin yin 王時敏印; Xunzhi 遜之.
2 additional seals: 1 of Jiang Gusun [Chiang Ku-sun] 將穀孫 (20th century); 1 of C. C. Wang 王季遷 (1907–2003).
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: C. C. Wang 王季遷 [1907–2003], New York, NY, sold to Mrs. A. Dean Perry
Mrs. A. Dean [Helen Wade Greene] Perry [1911-1996], Cleveland, OH, bequest to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。
